title: Purchase: a subscription that lapsed
summary: The purchase drawer for Jonas's Diceroll Plus subscription on the App Store, from a free trial through renewals and Apple's billing retry to the lapse, with what each step did to his license: Plus added at the trial, kept through renewals and the retry, removed at the lapse, the rest of the license untouched.
compare: The timeline is the subscription's life in the store's words (trial, renewed, billing retry, lapsed), each license effect on its own line (added, kept, removed) (admin-3-21, guide p324).
Lapsed is a neutral pill with a minus glyph: the end of a subscription is a fact, not an error; a refund keeps the danger tone (commerce.purchase).
No invented rules: the add-on is kept during billing retry and removed at the lapse as LX-23/LX-41 define; nothing celebrates (MO).
One leading glyph in the head (the store's mark), the Commerce green rule; Re-verify is the one action, outlined; the store link leaves the app (↗).
Phone: a bottom sheet, the timeline scrolling, the actions pinned.
